$comment: Completion bar for #216: a spaced-review scheduler over the user's notes. A versioned review_schedule table stores per-note due date, interval, ease and history; a pure SM-2-style scheduler expands intervals on Good/Easy and resets on Again, with an optional exam-date anchor (Cepeda et al. 2008); a Review panel lists due notes, reveals the cited note as feedback, and records a grade. FSRS stays out of scope. Verified failing first: no review module/panel/handler, no test:review.
